trace.name: brain.pagerank
trace.cypher: CALL algo.pageRank('Dev','CREDITS') YIELD node, score RETURN node.name AS dev, score

trace.name: brain.helped
trace.cypher: MATCH (d:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (other:Dev)-[c:CREDITS]->(d) RETURN d.name AS dev, t.name AS team, coalesce(sum(c.count), 0) AS helped

trace.name: brain.at_risk
trace.cypher: MATCH (s:Solution {status:'active'})<-[:PRODUCED]-(:Session)<-[:RAN]-(d:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) WHERE s.effort_minutes >= 240 OPTIONAL MATCH (other:Session)-[:REUSED]->(s) OPTIONAL MATCH (other)<-[:RAN]-(od:Dev) WHERE od <> d WITH s, d, t, count(DISTINCT od) AS others WHERE others = 0 RETURN s.id AS id, s.title AS title, d.name AS dev, t.name AS team, s.effort_minutes AS effort, s.attempts AS attempts ORDER BY effort DESC LIMIT $k

trace.name: brain.savings
trace.cypher: MATCH (d:Dev)-[:RAN]->(:Session)-[r:REUSED]->(:Solution) WHERE r.outcome IN ['reused','worked'] MATCH (d)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name AS team, sum(r.tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved, count(r) AS reuses ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC

trace.name: brain.help_flows
trace.cypher: MATCH (a:Dev)-[c:CREDITS]->(b:Dev) MATCH (a)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(ta:Team), (b)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(tb:Team) WHERE ta <> tb RETURN tb.name AS from_team, ta.name AS to_team, sum(c.count) AS count ORDER BY count DESC
